```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(htmltools)

source(here::here("R/legislature/06_weekly_activity.R"))
source(here::here("R/legislature/ui_helpers.R"))

bill_actions <- load_bill_actions()
weeks <- weekly_activity_summary(bill_actions)   # newest first; one row per page
latest <- latest_active_week(bill_actions)
data_through <- max(bill_actions$date)

fmt_day   <- \(d) str_squish(format(d, "%b %e"))
fmt_long  <- \(d) str_squish(format(d, "%B %e, %Y"))
week_href <- \(d) paste0(format(d, "%Y-%m-%d"), ".html")
```

```{r}
div(class = "ia-hero-row",
  div(
    div(class = "ia-eyebrow", "91st General Assembly"),

    p(class = "ia-lead",
      "What the Legislature did each week: bills introduced, moved through ",
      "subcommittee and committee, passed by a chamber, and signed into law.")
  ),
  div(class = "ia-week-nav",
    a(href = week_href(latest), paste("Most recent: week of", fmt_day(latest), "→")))
)
```

```{r}
count_cell <- function(n) tags$td(class = "ia-num", if (n == 0) span(class = "ia-zero", "–") else format(n, big.mark = ","))

# Full wording on desktop, a short form on phones (custom.scss toggles them)
both <- function(full, short) tagList(span(class = "ia-full", full), span(class = "ia-short", short))

week_row <- function(w) {
  label <- a(href = week_href(w$week_start),
             span(class = "ia-full", "Week of "), fmt_day(w$week_start))
  if (!w$active) {
    return(tags$tr(class = "ia-week-quiet",
      tags$th(scope = "row", label),
      tags$td(colspan = 5, class = "ia-week-note", both("Procedural actions only", "Procedural only")),
      tags$td(class = "ia-num", format(w$n_actions, big.mark = ","))
    ))
  }
  tags$tr(
    tags$th(scope = "row", label,
            if (w$vetoed > 0) span(class = "ia-week-note",
                                   span(class = "ia-full", " · "), sprintf("%d vetoed", w$vetoed))),
    count_cell(w$introduced), count_cell(w$subcommittee), count_cell(w$committee),
    count_cell(w$floor), count_cell(w$signed),
    tags$td(class = "ia-num ia-week-actions", format(w$n_actions, big.mark = ","))
  )
}

# A visible break wherever the Legislature went quiet for more than a week
gap_row <- function(newer, older) {
  tags$tr(class = "ia-week-gap",
    tags$td(colspan = 7, sprintf("No recorded actions · %s – %s",
                                 fmt_day(older + 7), fmt_day(newer - 1))))
}

year_table <- function(yr) {
  ws <- weeks |> filter(format(week_start, "%Y") == yr)
  rows <- list()
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(ws))) {
    if (i > 1 && as.numeric(ws$week_start[i - 1] - ws$week_start[i]) > 7) {
      rows <- c(rows, list(gap_row(ws$week_start[i - 1], ws$week_start[i])))
    }
    rows <- c(rows, list(week_row(ws[i, ])))
  }
  div(class = "ia-card ia-week-year",
    div(class = "ia-card-title", yr),
    div(class = "ia-table-scroll",
      tags$table(class = "ia-week-table",
        tags$thead(tags$tr(
          tags$th(scope = "col", "Week"),
          tags$th(scope = "col", class = "ia-num", both("Introduced", "Intro")),
          tags$th(scope = "col", class = "ia-num", both("Passed subcommittee", "Subcmte")),
          tags$th(scope = "col", class = "ia-num", both("Passed committee", "Cmte")),
          tags$th(scope = "col", class = "ia-num", both("Passed a chamber", "Floor")),
          tags$th(scope = "col", class = "ia-num", "Signed"),
          tags$th(scope = "col", class = "ia-num ia-week-actions", "All actions")
        )),
        tags$tbody(rows)
      )
    )
  )
}

tagList(
  lapply(sort(unique(format(weeks$week_start, "%Y")), decreasing = TRUE), year_table),
  div(class = "ia-footnote",
    "Counts are bill groups — a bill together with its companion bills and the ",
    "study bill it came from — reaching each stage during the week. ",
    "\"All actions\" counts every recorded action, procedural ones included. ",
    sprintf("Data through %s.", fmt_long(data_through)))
)
```
